name: Komine Akina
source:
“Big sis...” she's the kind of cousin you just want to cuddle up on her lap. She's also Natsuko's younger sister.

In contrast to Natsuko, she's quiet and gentle, treating you with feminine kindness— a beautiful older sister. However, she's quite stubborn and fixated on her ideas; once she decides on something, she sticks to it.

She's a domestic goddess. Cooking is her hobby, and she loves serving her dishes to the protagonist, though the taste of her cooking is immeasurable, an unknown flavor.

Having been frail since childhood, she's never left the village and is unfamiliar with the outside world—or rather, she has absolutely no interest in it.

She only learned the word “internet” from the protagonist very recently. Her overly sweet nature, her unconscious flirting, and her tendency to want to strip naked when drunk are all part of her charm.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080415135100/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/oneboku/top_off.html]archived official site[/url]]
